verdict.rationale: Treg is a tool catalog where buyers can fairly ask about pre-use inspection. You can search it (`/catalog/search`), compare providers per platform on measured success rate, speed and price (`/catalog/platforms/{slug}`), and every catalogued endpoint lists its price, parameters and an example response. However, the entries are upstream provider endpoints proxied through treg, not independently hosted servers, so nothing documents per-listing transport or hosting attributes. Missing for 10: formal input-schema documentation per tool beyond 'parameters', transport details, hosting attributes, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the inspection flow.
